info.title: Eka Protocol API
info.description: Hospital workflows for IPD: rules, the tasks they create, and the forms filled on an admission.

tags.name: Tasks
tags.description: Workflow tasks at a hospital. Rules create them; users claim, release, complete and cancel them here. Task documents are also readable live from Firestore (`protocol/{bid}/tasks`) through `@orbi/protocol-sdk`; every change goes through this API.

tags.name: Forms
tags.description: Forms filled on an entity (today: an admission, the IPD Forms tab) and what happened to each.

tags.name: Rules
tags.description: Hospital workflow rules: events → conditions → tasks. Each save is a new version, compiled to a workflow.

tags.name: Catalog
tags.description: The events and fields rules are written against.

tags.name: Events
tags.description: Fire an event for a scope: every active rule on it starts a run.

tags.name: SA forms
tags.description: The hospital's SA forms (its own and the system ones), with versions and archiving.

tags.name: SA form drafts
tags.description: SA forms saved before they are ready. Not offered in IPD until published.

tags.name: AI drafts
tags.description: Draft an SA form from a prompt or a file with AI.
